name: bam-bam-cake-shop-ecosystem
comment:overrides: Pin a single react + react-native across the whole monorepo. Transitive deps (e.g. @react-navigation/*) were pulling react-native 0.85.2 / react 19.2.5 into the root while the apps use 0.83.6 / 19.2.0, causing two copies in the release bundle and the 'Cannot read property useEffect of null' crash.
